title: santolina cupressiformis
intro: Santolina cupressiformis, commonly known as gray lavender cotton or cotton lavender, is a perennial shrub native to the Mediterranean region, characterized by its silvery-gray foliage and small, yellowish flowers. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and improve respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Santolina cupressiformis include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, making it useful for topical applications and herbal teas. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
